findings.title: Concurrent delete still causes NPE in getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: In model/infinispan/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/cache/infinispan/GroupAdapter.java the three getSubGroupsStream overloads do return modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) with no null check. If the group is deleted concurrently, cacheSession.getGroupDelegate().getGroupById() returns null so modelSupplier.get() returns null and the dereference throws NullPointerException. The PR fixes the identical pattern in getSubGroupsCount() by returning null when the delegate is null, but leaves the overloads at lines 255, 261 and 267 unfixed, so the same concurrent delete during subgroup listing still causes NPE/500.

findings.title: Concurrent test thread is never joined and can leak/race
findings.body: In tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/tests/admin/group/GroupTest.java createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a new Thread that loops calling groups(null,0,Integer.MAX_VALUE,true) and discards the handle via new Thread(...).start(). The test then deletes groups, sets deletedAll to true, and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty without joining the reader. The assertion can run while a request is still in flight so later failures are missed, the reader can outlive the test and interfere with subsequent tests, and if the delete loop throws deletedAll is never set leaving an infinite tight busy-loop hammering the server.
